title: First Strike
description: Custom initiative tracker. Fluid, draggable, dockable anywhere in the UI, restyled to match the Embermark design language shared with Triad and Kronos (Cinzel/Spectral type, smoked-glass card, gold/ember/moss palette) - and when docked into Triad's Initiative tab, reads Triad's own color tokens directly so it blends in exactly, not just by coincidence. Picks up an encounter however it was started - First Strike's own Begin Encounter button, or Foundry's native right-click/combat-tracker toggle - and shows a Begin Encounter control inline until someone starts it. Always displays combatants sorted by current initiative, even if a roll made through Foundry's own native tracker hasn't re-sorted Foundry's internal turn order yet. Keeps the active turn pointed at the right combatant when a creature is added, removed, or has its initiative rolled/changed mid-fight, in any round. Auto-skip of defeated/hidden/delaying/surprised combatants respects direction, so stepping backward through a dead enemy lands on the previous living one instead of bouncing forward again. Players roll their own initiative locally (dialog and chat message on their own screen); only the final number is relayed to the GM's client to persist, since direct Combatant writes are rejected for players in this world. Marks the token itself as dead (native Foundry status) at 0 HP and clears it on healing. Delay/ready actions, an end-turn button so the active player can pass the turn themselves, upcoming-turn highlight, surprised-round-1 marking, roll-all-NPCs, keyboard shortcuts, compact active+next view, and shared party HP visibility.

recommends.reason: First Strike docks into Triad's Initiative tab when both are active.
